semiconductor_relevance: High — SICC Co., Ltd. specializes in silicon carbide substrates, which are critical for various semiconductor applications.
summary: SICC Co., Ltd. is a leading manufacturer of silicon carbide (SiC) substrate materials, recognized for its advanced technology and innovation in the semiconductor industry. The company produces the world's largest 8-inch SiC substrates and has received multiple national awards for its contributions to technology and manufacturing excellence.
capabilities: Development of advanced SiC substrate technologies

regional_presence.China: SICC Co., Ltd. is based in China and has established itself as a national leader in the silicon carbide substrate market.
